run_qemu_rnd_helper.cmd: echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVMCTL_START"; uservmctl stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if uservmctl start; then echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVMCTL_START_OK"; else rc=$?; echo "AUTOPILOT_FAIL: USERVMCTL_START_FAILED rc=$rc"; fi; uservmctl status | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_USERVM_STATUS: /'

emit_dump_timeout_diag.cmd: echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: NO_TRACE_DUMP_DIAG_BEGIN'; uservmctl status | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_USERVM_STATUS: /'; if [ -f /var/log/uservm/vm1-console.log ]; then tail -n 80 /var/log/uservm/vm1-console.log | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_USERVM_LOG: /'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVM_LOG_MISSING_ON_TIMEOUT'; fi; echo 'AUTOPILOT_FAIL: VIO_TRACE_DUMP_NOT_COMPLETED_AFTER_TIMEOUT'; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: NO_TRACE_DUMP_DIAG_END'

emit_qemu_bootstrap_diag.cmd: echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVM_BOOTSTRAP_DIAG_BEGIN'; uservmctl status | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_USERVM_STATUS: /'; if [ -f /run/uservm/vm1-supervisor.pid ]; then upid=$(cat /run/uservm/vm1-supervisor.pid); echo "AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVMCTL_RUNNING pid=$upid"; if [ -r /proc/$upid/comm ]; then printf 'AUTOPILOT_USERVM_PROC: pid=%s comm=%s\n' "$upid" "$(cat /proc/$upid/comm)"; fi; if [ -r /proc/$upid/cmdline ]; then tr '\000' ' ' < /proc/$upid/cmdline | sed "s/^/AUTOPILOT_USERVM_PROC: pid=$upid cmdline=/"; fi; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVMCTL_NOT_RUNNING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; fi; if [ -f /var/log/uservm/vm1-console.log ]; then tail -n 60 /var/log/uservm/vm1-console.log | sed 's/^/AUTOPILOT_USERVM_LOG: /'; else echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVM_LOG_MISSING_AFTER_LAUNCH'; fi; echo 'AUTOPILOT_INFO: USERVM_BOOTSTRAP_DIAG_END'
